contract: one physical Kafka payload record per accepted business event, no loss
limitations: bounded deterministic fault matrix, not an impossibility proof or a general correctness proof
synthetic ordered event batches; no production throughput claim
broker outages, disk loss, partition expansion and retention expiry not tested

fault_witnesses.stage: final lease check then actual Redis expiry then replacement publish then old-owner publish

fault_witnesses.stage: raw records visible while committed view empty
